title: Missing entries in file list via Filer API
body:
**Describe the bug**
I have a bucket in a filer with millions of files, so there is begin of list:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4ba42517-ecfb-4c31-8951-582b139f694d)

Then I make a simple script to enumerate it with *limit=1*
```
Request http://0.0.0.0:8888/buckets/*?limit=1
Request http://0.0.0.0:8888/buckets/*?limit=1&lastFileName=000001e67de39123f67b338aee64b8e3_component1_texture1.png
Request http://0.0.0.0:8888/buckets/*?limit=1&lastFileName=000001e67de39123f67b338aee64b8e3_icon.png
Request http://0.0.0.0:8888/buckets/*?limit=1&lastFileName=09abe86b62841a8816d2da191964fc47_component1_texture1.png
Request http://0.0.0.0:8888/buckets/*?limit=1&lastFileName=09abe86b62841a8816d2da191964fc47_icon.png
```

After 000001e67de39123f67b338aee64b8e3_icon.png exists more files starting with 000*, but Filer don't want to show it. For `lastFileName` I using a `LastFileName` from response:
```
Request http://0.0.0.0:8888/buckets/*?limit=1&lastFileName=000001e67de39123f67b338aee64b8e3_icon.png
{'Version': '30GB 3.73 6063a889e', 'Path': '/buckets/*', 'Entries': [{'FullPath': '/buckets/*/09abe86b62841a8816d2da191964fc47_component1_texture1.png', 'Mtime': '2024-04-11T14:03:46Z', 'Crtime': '2024-04-11T14:03:46Z', 'Mode': 432, 'Uid': 0, 'Gid': 0, 'Mime': '', 'TtlSec': 0, 'UserName': '', 'GroupNames': None, 'SymlinkTarget': '', 'Md5': 'tgfh25Ju88U8Hqbp4ZpCzA==', 'FileSize': 3557209, 'Rdev': 0, 'Inode': 0, 'Extended': None, 'chunks': [{'file_id': '586,0178637cf740f2ac', 'size': 3557209, 'modified_ts_ns': 1712844226454510231, 'e_tag': 'tgfh25Ju88U8Hqbp4ZpCzA==', 'fid': {'volume_id': 586, 'file_key': 24667004, 'cookie': 4148228780}}], 'HardLinkId': None, 'HardLinkCounter': 0, 'Content': None, 'Remote': None, 'Quota': 0}], 'Limit': 1, 'LastFileName': '09abe86b62841a8816d2da191964fc47_component1_texture1.png', 'ShouldDisplayLoadMore': True, 'EmptyFolder': False}
```

If I retreiving a file list with bigger limit, files between 000001e67de39123f67b338aee64b8e3_icon and 09abe86b62841a8816d2da191964fc47_component1_texture1 appears, but other ones is missing

**System Setup**
Seaweed 3.73, but I also was experiencing this issue almost a year ago
Redis3 backend

**Expected behavior**
Stop missing file entries in listing
